title: A software factory that reasons about the business.
intro: Factory is an agentic software engineering system. Its agents do not simply generate code from instructions. They first understand the business context, inspect the existing ecosystem, reason about possible implementations and coordinate the work required to evolve the software.

principles.title: Understand
principles.text: Discover the business, applications, architecture and existing implementation.

principles.title: Reason
principles.text: Analyze alternatives, dependencies, risks and consequences.

principles.title: Coordinate
principles.text: Specialized agents collaborate across domains and repositories.

principles.title: Build
principles.text: Governed tools implement the approved engineering plan.

principles.title: Validate
principles.text: Tests, reviews and ecosystem consistency checks verify the result.

principles.title: Evolve
principles.text: The software can continuously adapt as business requirements change.

questions: What does the company actually need?
How does this company operate today?
Which frontend screens and APIs are involved?
Which backend services, stored procedures and tables are involved?
Which AI agents need to participate?
Does the solution preserve the multi-company model?
How should the result be validated?
